Chapter 6912: Primeval Lifeform

Chapter 6912: Primeval Lifeform

“Open the primeval realm!” Guangmai raised the staff and channeled all of his dao power, primordial true blood, and everything else into it.

“Open the primeval realm!” The other immortals, willingly or not, followed suit.

Some regretted the decision to join the staff of authority, not thinking it would go this far. This was truly a last-ditch effort - either victory or death.

This went beyond just the immortals. All members of Stygian had agreed to this pact. Thus, this phenomenon gathered all their strength and essence.

Previously, to be fused with immortals was an honor and a blessing for all living beings. After all, if they were to die, their flesh and blood would be sent back to the pool.

In this case, losing to the mortal meant that everyone would be buried together.

“Boom!” Outside of Golden Lamp, all other living beings in Stygian had joined Devouring Alliance.

The massive influx of powers and life caused the staff of authority to light up resplendently.

Only this primordial light was left. It flowed back into the distant past, to a time when Mang was born.

Li Qiye was pulled back into this timeline while the others awakened something ancient. He saw a heavenly pond teeming with ever-evolving life. It had no form and grew at an insane rate.

He focused his gaze and saw its essence. Although it brimmed with light, it was made from countless creatures being refined by a special method. Darkness made them stronger. They were still conscious and continued to devour each other and grow, fusing into an ultimate being of evil.

This vile lifeform could split its molecules and then devour them, all the while fusing again to grow stronger. It had never appeared in the mortal world.

Alas, the separation of this primeval realm couldn’t escape the high heaven’s punishment. All life was under the jurisdiction of the high heaven, whether part of the light or darkness.

Thus, terrible tribulations immediately descended to attack.

“Raa!” The vile lifeform roared and absorbed the tribulations, still growing stronger.

“Ahh!” On the other hand, those from Stygian endured the pain of the tribulations. As long as the vile lifeform was alive, so would they.

Of course, the tribulations never relented and filled up the whole primeval realm. The more the lifeform grew, the more furious the tribulations became.

This level of punishment could obliterate a primordial immortal many times over.

“High Heaven Obliteration!” Guangmai and the others understood this was the limit. They immediately sent all of the tribulations within the lifeform toward Li Qiye.

The goal of this grand momentum was to summon this unknown lifeform to absorb tribulations. The true weapon was the high heaven.

“Not bad at all.” Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile upon seeing the successful transfer.
